# `aitbc agent-comm monitor`

Monitor cross-chain agent communication in real time or at an interval.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent-comm monitor [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--realtime` | flag | `false` | no | Real-time monitoring |
| `--interval` | integer | `10` | no | Update interval in seconds |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent-comm monitor
```
